items.name: boot-log
items.title: BootLog
items.description: Boot-sequence log: lines typed one after another with timestamps and status tags, in a role=log live region (polite). Runs longer than 5 s get pause/resume and skip controls. Reduced or off motion prints every line at once.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The boot sequence is illustrative text generated from the props; no original assets are used. v4 migration: the log keeps only the lines reached so far inside role=log (unreached text is not in the accessibility tree or the live region), while an aria-hidden ghost copy of every line reserves the final height from the first frame. Fail lines no longer type: they render once through Glitch (`@yorha/decipher`). Status marks are a Glyph (`@yorha/glyph`) plus the text tag. The log is focusable until it finishes; a click or any key on it skips the run. Add `@yorha/typer`, `@yorha/glyph` and `@yorha/decipher` to a hand-copied install.
